sermon.title: The Glory of the Lord - Part 2 - September 25, 2022
sermon.speaker: Michael Silla
sermon.summary: Jesus is the King of glory, and praise opens the gates. Praise and the word are a two-edged sword that strengthens us, binds kings and shook Paul and Silas’s prison. God gives fresh glory to those who repent, arise and shine; the latter house’s glory will exceed the former.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Opening scripture and worship by others; message from ~20:50.

faqs.question: Why are gates important?
faqs.answer: They open and close, and are where you are vulnerable.

faqs.answer: Every believer has something to say.

faqs.answer: He says praise is for you.

How bright does God make us?
